notes:
- Play mode: walk on the map at eye height (ZQSD / WASD, Shift run, Space jump, swim)
- The game's sea: swell, waves along the shore, foam, sun glints; pools and rivers filled
- Smooth streaming like the game: no holes or floating buildings while the city loads
- Shadows up to 1 km, haze 12 km, view distance x2, anisotropic x16
- File > Import map folder: open a whole FiveM map resource in MAP mode
- Terrain layers paint on your own maps with big triangles
- Polymorph Discord: https://discord.gg/RWB28mvJU9
